title: Burns calls Roger Clemens a traitor after Toronto signing
book_use: Near-contemporaneous account of Burns using the State Department briefing podium for a comic Red Sox/Clemens aside; supports public-persona argument but exact wording remains AP-attributed pending official transcript/video recovery

title: A Farewell Curveball for State's Spokesman
book_use: Independently recalls Burns's Clemens podium joke and documents press-corps recognition of his Red Sox identity while he awaited confirmation for Greece; useful corroboration, not an official transcript

title: State Department Briefing 1996
book_use: Catalog confirms surviving State Department briefing-room video from Dec. 13 1996 (record 261702), creating a concrete audiovisual retrieval route for the same week; does not itself establish that this clip contains the Clemens exchange
